paragraphs: Hurricane wind on solar farms: ordered damage-state curves with judgment-based synthetic resistance medians and cost ratios (cell-local decision, no direct TC calibration source); one module route fitted to NREL satellite storm-damage records. It names 8 parts: PV module field, PV module hardware, satellite-data route, Mounting structure, Foundations, Power conversion and collection, GSU and substation, SCADA and communications and Civil infrastructure. Outside its scope: storm surge, flood, tornado and straight-line convective wind (separate pathways or cells), hail, lightning and fire, downtime, business interruption and insurance terms and soft, sunk and non-physical cost (installed capex above physical replacement value). Kinds of damage it does not include: windborne debris impact as a separately valued pathway and wind-driven rain and water ingress.

For this hazard the solar farm is split into 8 parts: PV module field, PV module hardware, satellite-data route, Mounting structure, Foundations, Power conversion and collection, GSU and substation, SCADA and communications and Civil infrastructure. Parts of the plant's value with no curve yet: replacement support (inspection, labour, rental, logistics, removal): no own curve; takes the value-weighted damage ratio of the other parts and is counted once.

steps.meaning: How the hazard is measured, the shape of the curve, and the site adjustments
steps.fact: 3 hazard measures → a line through points + damage states
paragraphs: Damage is read against event maximum gust (Perry dataset) (m/s), architecture-specific demand index (event / design pressure ratio) and site-facility demand ratio (event / design pressure). The curves take 2 forms: a line through fixed points (piecewise linear); ordered damage states, each reached with a lognormal chance as demand rises. The input, in the catalogue's words: demand ratio 0 to 2, withheld above 2: arrays use event/design net pressure (fixed tilt) or tracker-normal gust / exact-system critical gust (tracker); site facilities use event/design wind pressure or a gust-squared proxy. The satellite-data module route uses event maximum gust, 17.4 to 39.1 m/s.
